criteria.notes: The app proves the requested shared Studio runtime contract with selectable destinations, matching 2D and 3D views, route rendering, and touch camera controls.
The scene uses the reviewed synthetic campus artifact directly; all six authored destinations, origin, colors, heights, labels, and route geometry remain recognizable in both views.
Extruded destination masses, billboard labels, a restrained isometric camera, and the paired directory create a distinct spatial wayfinding composition rather than a generic dashboard.
Destination names, view controls, directory entries, and the selected-state guidance remain legible at Full HD and 1366x768 without clipped text.
Light and dark screenshots preserve readable labels, controls, directory dividers, and highlighted actions; the white floor plane remains a deliberate map surface in dark mode.
The tested destination labels fit their authored spaces, directory rows preserve hierarchy, and the title uses bounded ellipsis with descender-safe padding.
The map remains the primary surface, all six spaces stay inside the camera frame, and the directory occupies a stable secondary column at both tested sizes.
The runtime artifact supplies coherent per-space colors and elevations; 2D and 3D modes, light and dark presets, and the verified placeholder contain no missing assets.
The full-bleed interactive spatial scene, extrusion controls, and shared 2D/3D artifact are materially different from the maintained table, queue, dashboard, menu, and feed examples.

screenshots.notes: Full HD 3D render inspected: all six extruded spaces, labels, origin, controls, and directory are visible with no clipping or overlap.
Compact 3D render inspected: the complete scene remains framed and every destination stays identifiable.
Default scenario inspected at Full HD; it preserves the approved composition and differs only by animation timing.
Compact scenario inspected; labels, directory rows, and controls remain within their surfaces.
Dark scenario inspected; text and control contrast remain clear and the map masses are visually distinct.
Flat 2D scenario inspected; all six regions, the central circulation band, and the origin marker are clear with no overflow.
